seo.title: IHOT Robotics | FRC Team 1414
seo.description: IHOT Robotics is FIRST Robotics Competition Team 1414 from Atlanta International School. Guides, training and resources for programming, CAD, fabrication, electrical, operations and scouting.

hero.headline: Built by students.
hero.subheadline: IHOT Robotics designs, builds and programs a competition robot every season. This is our team hub: every guide, template and lesson our six subteams rely on, all in one place.

stats.label: Rookie year: two decades of FRC
Qualified for the 2024 FIRST Championship in Houston

subteamsIntro.title: Find your place on the team
subteamsIntro.text: Every IHOT robot is the work of six subteams that depend on each other. Pick one to see what they do, then dive into their resources.

subteams.name: Programming
subteams.summary: We turn motors and sensors into a robot that can drive itself. Programmers write the code for our swerve drive, autonomous routines and driver controls, then tune it on the practice field until it is match-ready.

subteams.name: CAD
subteams.tagline: Design every part before we make it
subteams.summary: Every part of the robot exists in CAD before it exists in aluminum. Our designers model mechanisms in Onshape, check gear ratios and weight, and produce the drawings that fabrication cuts from.

subteams.name: Fabrication
subteams.summary: Fabrication brings the design to life. Members learn to use the shop's tools safely, from hand tools and drill presses to CNC machines, and turn CAD drawings into precise, reliable robot parts.

subteams.name: Electrical
subteams.summary: Electrical wires everything together: batteries, breakers, motor controllers, sensors and the CAN network. Clean, labeled and serviceable wiring is how we keep the robot running through a long event.

subteams.name: Operations
subteams.summary: Operations keeps the whole team moving. From sponsorships and budgets to outreach, social media and event logistics, this subteam builds the relationships and resources that make every season possible.

subteams.name: Scouting
subteams.summary: Scouting wins matches before they start. Scouts collect data on every robot at an event, turn it into match strategy and pick lists, and give our drive team an edge in eliminations.

about.title: Two decades of students building robots
paragraphs: IHOT Robotics is FIRST Robotics Competition Team 1414, based at Atlanta International School in Atlanta, Georgia. We have been building robots since our rookie season in 2004.

Each season brings a brand-new game and a few short weeks to design, build and program a robot that can play it. Students lead every part of that process, with mentors who coach rather than build. Along the way, members pick up real engineering, business and leadership skills, and spend plenty of late nights in the shop.

sponsors.title: Powered by our partners
sponsors.text: IHOT runs on the generosity of partners who believe in hands-on STEM education. Thank you for making our season possible.

cta.title: Become a sponsor
cta.text: Sponsorships pay for parts, tools, event registration and travel. We would love to show you what your support builds.
cta.label: Get in touch

join.title: No experience needed. Just curiosity.
join.text: If you are curious, willing to learn and ready to be part of a team, there is a place for you on IHOT, whether that is writing code, machining parts or leading outreach.

steps.title: Come to an interest meeting
steps.text: We hold them at the start of the school year. Watch for announcements at school and on our Instagram.

steps.title: Try every subteam
steps.text: New members get to see programming, CAD, fabrication, electrical, operations and scouting before choosing a focus.

steps.title: Learn with this hub
steps.text: Every subteam keeps its training guides here, so you can get up to speed at your own pace.

join.contactText: Students, parents, mentors and sponsors are all welcome to reach out.
